document_metadata.title: 1、EXT. SLATE QUARRY - DAY
document_metadata.summary: A Rube Goldberg machine on a Bedrock lawn activates spinning woolly mammoths that spray water, one complaining of aching sinuses, blending prehistoric elements with automated suburban routines.

entities.name: Fred Flintstone operates dinosaur-powered quarry equipment
entities.description: Fred Flintstone uses a winch to control a heavy-equipment dinosaur that tears into a quarry wall during work hours.

entities.name: Quarry foreman checks magic wrist sundial for quitting time
entities.description: The quarry foreman consults his magical wrist sundial and determines that it is time to end the workday.

entities.name: Foreman activates steam whistle bird to signal end of workday
entities.description: The quarry foreman pulls the tail of a steam-powered whistle bird, causing it to squawk and signal the end of the workday.

entities.name: Fred Flintstone celebrates end of workday with yell and departure
entities.description: Upon hearing the quitting-time signal, Fred yells 'Yabba Dabba Do', discards his hard hat, slides down the dinosaur's tail, and jumps into his stone car.

entities.name: Fred Flintstone clocks out using dinosaur time clock
entities.description: Fred slows his stone car to allow a dinosaur-operated time clock to punch his stone timecard before leaving the quarry.

entities.name: Fred Flintstone arrives home at his ranch cave in Bedrock
entities.description: Fred skids to a stop in the driveway of his three-bedroom ranch cave home, marking his return from work.

entities.name: Wilma and Pebbles Flintstone exit house and enter car
entities.description: Wilma and their daughter Pebbles run out of the cave house and get into Fred's stone car in preparation for an outing.

entities.name: Flintstone pets exit house and join car
entities.description: The Flintstone family pets, Dino and the saber-toothed cat, follow Wilma and Pebbles out of the house and enter the vehicle.

entities.name: Fred honks horn to summon Rubble family
entities.description: Fred sounds his car horn, prompting Barney, Betty, and Bam-Bam Rubble to come out of their neighboring house.

entities.name: Rubble family joins Flintstones in car
entities.description: Barney, Betty, and Bam-Bam exit their home and hop into Fred's stone car to join the group outing.

entities.name: Drive-In Movie Outing With Flintstone And Rubble Families
entities.description: The Flintstone and Rubble families attend a drive-in movie theater together, hooking up a giant shell speaker and settling in to watch a film.
entities.summary: The Flintstone and Rubble families attend a drive-in movie theater together, hooking up a giant shell speaker and settling in to watch a film.

entities.name: Fred attaches giant shell speaker to car at drive-in
entities.description: Fred removes a large sea shell speaker from a wooden stand and connects it to his car door to hear the movie audio.

entities.name: Fred embraces Wilma at drive-in movie
entities.description: Fred leans over and puts his arm around Wilma as they prepare to watch the movie together.

entities.name: Dino tears through car top to get better view
entities.description: Dino pops his head through the canvas roof of the car, breaking through the material to improve his view of the screen.

entities.name: Dino lifts Pebbles and Bam-Bam onto his head
entities.description: Dino picks up the children Pebbles and Bam-Bam and places them on top of his head so they can see the movie better.

entities.name: Main credits of The Flintstones appear on drive-in screen
entities.description: The words 'THE FLINTSTONES' appear on the drive-in movie screen, followed by the rolling of the main credits in dramatic fashion.

entities.name: Transition to eerie Carboniferous forest at dawn
entities.description: The scene dissolves to a primordial forest at dawn, featuring giant dragonflies, strange plants, and lungfish emerging from a pond, one carrying a suitcase.

entities.description: A colloquial temporal reference indicating the end of the workday, used to signal when Fred and others stop working at the quarry.

entities.name: Fred Flintstone
entities.description: The main character and archetypical Everyman who works at a quarry using dinosaur-powered equipment and enjoys family outings with his loved ones.
entities.summary: Fred is a quarry worker and shop steward at Slate Construction, known as a family-oriented everyman who supports colleagues, runs for lodge office, and helps Barney Rubble advance his career while addressing safety concerns.

entities.description: Fred Flintstone's wife who participates in family activities including drive-in movie outings.
entities.summary: Wilma Flintstone, Fred's wife, participates in family activities, questions unusual production activity at home, and is introduced as Mrs. Slate's companion during a visit.

entities.name: Pebbles Flintstone
entities.description: The young daughter of Fred and Wilma Flintstone who joins her family at the drive-in movie and is lifted by Dino for a better view.
entities.summary: The young daughter of Fred and Wilma Flintstone who joins her family at the drive-in movie and is lifted by Dino for a better view.

entities.description: The Flintstone family pet, a dinosaur who shows affection and helps children see better at the drive-in by lifting them onto his head.
entities.summary: A pet dinosaur named Dino belongs to the Flintstone family, displaying playful, affectionate behavior with the family, participating in routines like fetching the newspaper, performing in talent shows, and undergoing humorous grooming experiences.

entities.summary: Fred Flintstone's neighbor and friend, who joins him for a drive-in movie, is introduced to a job opportunity at a construction site and participates in a rescue effort, questioning the legal implications of Slate's conditional offer.

entities.name: Camera discovers strange clawprints on muddy shore
entities.description: The camera pans past a lungfish and reveals a set of unusual, menacing clawprints on the muddy shoreline, drawing attention to their mysterious origin.

entities.name: Camera reveals seven-foot Xenosaurus creating clawprints
entities.description: The source of the clawprints is revealed to be a large, fearsome seven-foot creature called the Xenosaurus, standing on the shore and looking around menacingly.

entities.name: Garbage truck runs over Xenosaurus on gravel highway
entities.description: A garbage truck suddenly appears and runs over the Xenosaurus, which is now revealed to be on the shoulder of a gravel highway rather than in a wild forest.

entities.name: Xenosaurus rises dazed beside highway
entities.description: After being run over, the Xenosaurus slowly gets up, appearing disoriented and dazed on the side of the road.

entities.name: Camera reveals Bedrock city near highway exit
entities.description: The camera cranes up to show a stone road sign indicating Bedrock is half a mile away, followed by a wide view of the city nestled in a rugged landscape at dawn.

entities.name: muddy shore
entities.description: A muddy shore where strange clawprints are discovered, serving as the initial scene setting near the highway.

entities.name: shoulder of a gravel highway
entities.description: The location where the Xenosaurus is struck by a garbage truck, identified as the side of a gravel road leading to Bedrock.

entities.summary: Bedrock is the fictional prehistoric town where the Flintstones live, serving as the primary setting for the narrative and events such as the school and talent show, located near Slate City.

entities.summary: A large, prehistoric creature with green, scaly claws is observed near a muddy shore and highway, interacting with tools, a canvas bag, and a pocket sundial before entering the Fibre ride, leaving signs of disturbance.

document_metadata.title: 4、INT. FLINTSTONE KITCHEN - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Fred's car is damaged by a stray tablet, and after a brief moment of calm, a baby pterodactyl hatches from his egg, knocking him down and flying away, escalating the morning's chaos.

document_metadata.title: 21、INT. FLINTSTONE HOUSE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Wilma and Betty show Fred and Barney costly school forms; the men respond with stone contracts, revealing they've secured better deals, celebrating with champagne and reaffirming their friendship.

entities.name: Wilma and Betty discuss school enrollment forms and fees
entities.description: Wilma and Betty examine school enrollment forms, express concern over the non-refundable fee, and reflect on their impulsive decision to enroll their children in a new school due to the administrator's unpleasant attitude.

entities.name: Betty expresses regret over her impulsive decision
entities.description: Betty reveals her emotional turmoil and guilt over making a rash decision earlier in the day, admitting she felt pressured and overwhelmed during the school enrollment process.

entities.name: Wilma justifies joining Betty in enrolling the children
entities.description: Wilma explains that she also felt provoked by the school administrator's boastful comments about her nephew, leading her to impulsively support Betty's decision despite the financial consequences.

entities.name: Fred and Barney return home with candy and flowers
entities.description: Fred and Barney burst into the house carrying rock candy and flowers, surprising their wives with an unexpected gesture of affection and appreciation.

entities.name: Barney gives flowers to Betty as a token of appreciation
entities.description: Barney presents flowers to Betty, expressing gratitude for her support during difficult times and making her feel valued, despite her confession of having done something foolish.

entities.name: Fred jokes about doing something stupid every day
entities.description: In response to Betty's admission of making a stupid decision, Fred lightens the mood by acknowledging that he does something foolish daily, reinforcing the group's sense of humor and camaraderie.

entities.name: Fred reveals a bottle of champagne
entities.description: After being questioned about their behavior, Fred produces a bottle of champagne to celebrate, noting the year '1' on the label, which confuses the women further.

entities.name: Wilma questions whether Fred and Barney have been drinking
entities.description: Wilma observes Fred and Barney's unusual behavior and directly asks if they have been drinking alcohol, prompting Fred to reveal the champagne.

entities.name: that time
entities.description: A relative temporal reference to a past event involving a burglar and Fred and Barney being forced to go bowling.

entities.name: door
entities.description: The entrance through which Fred and Barney enter, marking the location of their sudden arrival.

entities.name: Wilma Flintstone
entities.description: A woman involved in enrolling children in school and discussing the decision with her friend Betty; she is married to Fred.
entities.summary: Fred's wife interacts with family and neighbors, manages household tasks, addresses a dino kibble shortage, reassures Pebbles, prepares children for school, and visits the butcher shop with Betty, where she helps defuse tension and makes requests for Fred.

entities.name: Betty Rubble
entities.description: A woman who impulsively enrolls her child in a new school and later expresses regret; she is married to Barney.
entities.summary: A mother helps prepare children for nursery, drives them to school, interacts with Wilma and Mrs. Slate, parks legally using a stone coin, and visits Morris the Butcher's store during a rush.

entities.name: Fred
entities.description: Wilma's husband who returns home with candy and flowers; jokes about doing something stupid every day and reveals a bottle of champagne.
entities.summary: A man engages with his family and neighbors in morning routines, car repairs, and shared moments, while reflecting on dreams and offering advice, showing affection and concern in everyday interactions.

entities.name: Barney Rubble
entities.description: Betty's husband who returns home with Fred, gives Betty flowers, and supports her emotionally despite her regret over a decision.
entities.summary: Fred interacts with imaginative neighbors, including a dreamer who repairs a car hood and shares memories, while a worker secures a crane on a dino structure and Fred's companion fills out job forms at a quarry.

document_metadata.title: 26、EXT. QUARRY - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Fred is credited for Fibrerock's success, but workers are shocked when Slate announces layoffs, replacing adults with children; Fred, blamed by coworkers, resolves to take action.

entities.name: Fred makes a quick turn into the quarry lot with Barney
entities.description: Fred drives his car and abruptly turns into the quarry lot, narrowly avoiding detection by Feldspar's patrol car, with both he and Barney ducking down behind the wheel to stay hidden.

entities.name: Feldspar patrols the quarry without spotting Fred and Barney
entities.description: Feldspar drives past Fred and Barney in his patrol car, looking around suspiciously but failing to notice them hiding in the car.

entities.name: Barney compliments Fred's driving as thrilling
entities.description: After Feldspar passes, Barney remarks that driving with Fred is more exciting than an 'E' ticket ride at Magerock Mountain, expressing admiration for the adrenaline rush.

entities.name: Fred expresses need for adrenaline as a big executive
entities.description: Fred gets out of the car and comments that the thrill of evasive driving stimulates his mind, claiming such jolts are necessary for executives like himself to stay sharp.

entities.name: Lava approaches Fred and Barney with construction plans
entities.description: Lava enters the scene carrying a stack of blueprints and greets Fred and Barney, introducing himself as Jerry and informing them that Mister Slate assigned him to escort them to their offices.

entities.name: Fred notices construction activity replacing the basketball court
entities.description: Fred observes a busy worksite where workers and animals are assembling scaffolding and constructing the Fibrerock assembly line, recognizing it is built over the former employee basketball court.

entities.name: Lava explains the Fibrerock assembly line progress
entities.description: Lava informs Fred and Barney that a crew has been working all weekend on the Fibrerock assembly line and that the first sheets will be produced by mid-week, as per Mister Slate's orders.

entities.name: Fred approves of rapid market entry strategy
entities.description: Fred acknowledges the fast-paced development of Fibrerock with approval, emphasizing the importance of a quick and dynamic entry into the marketplace.

entities.name: Barney expresses concern about loss of employee basketball court
entities.description: Barney points out to Fred that the new Fibrerock assembly line has replaced the employee basketball court, showing discomfort with the sacrifice made for business expansion.

entities.name: Fred reflects on the harsh realities of big business
entities.description: Fred acknowledges Barney's observation with resignation, stating that big business is inherently difficult and that Barney will eventually become accustomed to such trade-offs.

entities.name: Lava escorts Fred and Barney to their new offices
entities.description: Lava leads Fred and Barney to a modest wood-sided trailer where their new offices are located, instructing them to join the assembly line team later to review the Fibrerock formula.

entities.name: Fred and Barney discover their small, poorly furnished offices
entities.description: Inside the trailer, Fred and Barney find two cramped desks separated by a flimsy divider, threadbare furniture, a worn rug, and a view of the quarry scrap heap through a single window.

entities.name: Fred and Barney celebrate their promotion despite office conditions
entities.description: After initially reacting with disappointment, Fred and Barney exchange high-fives and celebrate their new executive status, embracing their rise to the top despite the underwhelming office setup.

document_metadata.title: 27、INT. SLATE'S OFFICE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Slate mocks firing employees, then uses a joke to pressure Fred into leaving after criticizing his PR for Fibrerock, threatening his job to make him quit.

entities.name: Slate practices golf putting into automatic cup
entities.description: Slate repeatedly hits golf balls into an automatic putting cup in what appears to be a routine or recreational activity.

entities.description: A golf ball shoots back from the putting cup, surprising Slate, who then re-tees the ball to continue practicing.

entities.name: Mouse expresses relief and returns golf ball
entities.description: After catching the ball, the mouse lifts its hockey mask, comments on the difficulty despite it being pre-season, and hits the ball back to Slate.

entities.name: Fred bursts into room and startles Slate
entities.description: Fred forcefully enters the room by banging the door open, causing Slate to become startled and accidentally drive the golf ball instead of putting it.

entities.description: The golf ball driven by Slate after being startled flies across the room and breaks a picture frame containing a portrait of Mrs. Slate.

entities.description: Slate reacts furiously to Fred's intrusion and the broken portrait, addressing him by his last name as an expression of anger.

entities.name: Fred insists on urgent discussion about employees
entities.description: Fred tells Mr. Slate they must talk about the long-term employees outside who cannot be laid off abruptly, emphasizing their years of service.

entities.name: Slate remains calm and considers Fred's words
entities.description: After initially reacting with anger, Slate composes himself, looks to Lava for input, then calmly toys with his putter while processing Fred's message.

entities.summary: A project developer and Slate Construction leadership face financial, logistical, and structural crises, leading to office destruction, emotional reactions, and a pivotal shift toward a new construction era with the Fibrerock name, while key figures make decisions about Slate City's development.

entities.description: An individual who bursts into Slate's office to urgently discuss the employment status of long-term workers.
entities.summary: A man engages with his family and neighbors in morning routines, car repairs, and shared moments, while reflecting on dreams and offering advice, showing affection and concern in everyday interactions.

entities.summary: Various characters at Slate Construction and Harvrock University react to the Fibrerock project, office collapse, and Fred and Barney's recognition, including a financial advisor explaining deficits, a worker mistaking debris for Slate's body, and staff involved in project presentations and office operations.

entities.name: Fred

entities.description: The presiding officer of the Buffalo Lodge meeting responsible for overseeing procedural motions and maintaining order.
entities.summary: The presiding officer leads the Loyal Order of Water Buffaloes meeting at the Grand Bedrock Lodge, maintaining order, conducting rituals, presenting Fred with a ceremonial hoof and antler, and announcing an upcoming officer vote.

entities.name: Pyrite
entities.description: An angry member of the Buffalo Lodge who accuses Fred of betrayal and supports moving forward with the election.
entities.summary: A companion of Piltdown who challenges Fred with walnut smashing, aids in falsely accusing him, and supports Piltdown's complaints at the lodge, later joining others in accusing Fred of betrayal and pushing for the election.

entities.name: Piltdown

entities.summary: A wrecking ball operator engages in unauthorized target practice; a worker sabotages Fred, falsely blaming him; a lodge member protests bias using the Cry of the Gelded Buffalo; another lodge member scowls at Fred; a member joins Fred at a bar; and a Lava employee acts as a thug and later a union provocateur.

entities.name: Loyal Order Of Water Buffaloes
entities.description: A fraternal organization of quarry workers that serves as a social and ceremonial institution separate from the workplace.
entities.summary: A fraternal organization of quarry workers that serves as a social and ceremonial institution separate from the workplace.

entities.name: Fibrerock
entities.description: A company or project referenced in connection with a controversial event that led to job losses and tensions within the Buffalo Lodge.
entities.summary: Barney is involved in a new business initiative at Slate Quarry developing a synthetic material for construction and household products, with potential profit share, while Fred Flintstone's invention could revolutionize the Stone Age, and a controversial project impacted the Buffalo Lodge.

entities.name: Fred's campaign poster
entities.description: A physical poster promoting Fred's re-election that has been vandalized with horns, a beard, and altered text reading "Fred Finkstone".

entities.name: chair
entities.description: The seat Fred occupies at the lodge meeting, symbolizing his usual place among the group before realizing his isolation.

entities.name: Barney attempts to recall and repeat Fred's campaign phrase
entities.description: Barney tries to remember Fred's campaign slogan, awkwardly paraphrasing it with humorous alterations, and winks at Fred, who groans in response.

entities.name: Herdmaster commands the Buffaloes to cast their secret vote
entities.description: The Herdmaster initiates the voting ritual by instructing the Buffaloes to cover their eyes with their fezzes in preparation for the secret ballot.

entities.name: Buffaloes perform the voting ritual with stomp and snort
entities.description: Following the Herdmaster's commands, the Buffaloes stomp like bulls and emit loud snorts to vote for their chosen candidate, first for Piltdown and then for Flintstone.

entities.name: Fred receives only one vote in the lodge election
entities.description: After the voting, it becomes clear that Fred is nearly unanimously rejected, with only Barney casting a single, lonely snort in his support.

entities.name: Herdmaster declares Piltdown the winner of the election
entities.description: The Herdmaster announces that Piltdown has won the election by the sound of the snorts and formally recognizes him as the new Exalted Herdmaster.

entities.name: Piltdown is installed as the new Exalted Herdmaster
entities.description: Piltdown approaches the podium to receive the official tokens of office from the outgoing Herdmaster, marking his formal ascension to leadership.

entities.name: Barney comforts Fred after his election loss
entities.description: Seeing Fred devastated by his defeat, Barney moves closer and puts his arm around him, reassuring him that he voted for him.

document_metadata.title: 31、INT. LODGE HALL
document_metadata.summary: Barney alerts Fred that the Buffaloes, led by Piltdown, are heading to the quarry to sabotage the assembly line, risking arrest; Fred agrees they must stop them.

entities.name: Fred accuses Barney of causing problems
entities.description: Fred angrily blames Barney for ruining things, speaking harshly without considering Barney's feelings.

entities.name: Barney reacts to Fred's accusation with hurt and distance
entities.description: Barney is visibly wounded by Fred's words and physically moves away from him on the bench, showing emotional distress.

entities.description: Piltdown receives the decorated fez and shoulder ribbon as a formal gesture during the lodge gathering, acknowledging his role.

entities.description: Piltdown reveals that most lodge members, who are also part of Amalgamated Neolithic, will be unable to make their cave payments next month.

entities.description: Piltdown declares that the planned agenda is canceled and shifts focus to immediate action against the Slate shop.

entities.description: Piltdown delivers a rallying speech urging the Buffaloes to stand up as men and sabotage the Slate shop by disabling heavy equipment.

entities.name: Group collectively shifts attention to Fred and back
entities.description: All members of the lodge turn to look at Fred after Piltdown's implication, then look back at Piltdown, signaling shared judgment.

entities.name: Buffalo Lodge meeting adjourns in anger
entities.description: The meeting officially ends as members express anger, throw fezzes into cubby holes, put on hard hats, and prepare to leave.

entities.name: Buffaloes exit the meeting with threats and determination
entities.description: The lodge members leave the gathering angrily, muttering threats and preparing to take action against the Slate shop.

document_metadata.summary: Barney saves Fred by crashing into Piltdown, sending them all into police arriving at the scene; Fred's head falls off but he emerges from clay as officers arrest them.

entities.name: Piltdown and Pyrite rejoin the factory rampage
entities.description: Piltdown and Pyrite return to the factory floor and re-engage in destructive actions, expressing anger toward Fred and Barney and preparing to confront them.

entities.name: Piltdown threatens Fred and Barney with physical harm
entities.description: Piltdown suggests sending Fred and Barney to the hospital, indicating violent intent, while gripping a wrench as a weapon.

entities.name: Piltdown encourages rampaging workers
entities.description: As rebellious workers pass by, Piltdown cheers them on, reinforcing their disruptive behavior in the factory.

entities.name: Piltdown and Pyrite lead workers to the assembly line catwalk
entities.description: Piltdown and Pyrite direct a group of disruptive workers up a staircase to the elevated catwalk above the assembly line.

entities.name: Pyrite smashes light fixtures with a club
entities.description: Pyrite uses a club to destroy several light fixtures on the catwalk, contributing to the chaos in the factory.

entities.name: Piltdown breaks support beams and throws them below
entities.description: Using his strength, Piltdown snaps large support beams and hurls them down from the catwalk, endangering those below.

entities.name: Pyrite loses balance and falls after missing a swing
entities.description: While attempting to smash a light fixture, Pyrite's swing misses as the fixture pulls up, causing him to spin and fall to the ground.

entities.name: Barney reveals himself from the rafters holding a light fixture
entities.description: Barney drops into view, suspended horizontally from the ceiling structure while holding a light fixture, interrupting Pyrite's attack.

entities.name: Barney taunts Pyrite with a baseball metaphor
entities.description: Barney mocks Pyrite's failed attack by calling it a strike and joking about throwing a curveball, provoking Pyrite further.

entities.name: Pyrite chases Barney through the rafters
entities.description: Enraged by Barney's taunt, Pyrite jumps up and begins pursuing Barney across the overhead rafter system.

entities.name: Piltdown attempts to break another beam but encounters resistance
entities.description: Piltdown grabs a large beam and pulls down, but instead of breaking, it moves upward, confusing him with its unexpected motion.

entities.name: Piltdown discovers Fred is counterbalancing the beam
entities.description: After repeated motion, Piltdown looks under the beam and sees Fred hanging on the opposite end, revealing the source of the resistance.

entities.name: Fred attempts to reason with Piltdown
entities.description: Fred calls out to Piltdown, appealing for dialogue and de-escalation using a phrase about talking 'antler to antler'.

entities.name: Piltdown attacks the beam with Fred on the other end
entities.description: In response to Fred's appeal, Piltdown roars and begins violently slamming the girder up and down, trying to dislodge Fred.

entities.name: Fred escapes by sliding down the beam and jumping off
entities.description: Fred carefully moves along the shaking beam and leaps to safety just before Piltdown's actions cause the beam to rebound.

entities.name: Beam rebounds and strikes Piltdown on the head
entities.description: After Fred jumps off, the sudden release of weight causes the beam to snap downward and hit Piltdown, dazing him.

entities.name: Piltdown recovers and pursues Fred
entities.description: Despite being struck, Piltdown regains his senses quickly and runs off to chase after Fred.

entities.summary: A wrecking ball operator engages in unauthorized target practice; a worker sabotages Fred, falsely blaming him; a lodge member protests bias using the Cry of the Gelded Buffalo; another lodge member scowls at Fred; a member joins Fred at a bar; and a Lava employee acts as a thug and later a union provocateur.

document_metadata.title: 37、INT. LAVA'S OFFICE - DAY
document_metadata.summary: Lava offers Fred fame through TV exposure with Rockin' Leach, conditioning it on Fred abandoning Barney, who is being erased from Fibrerock's narrative.

entities.name: Lava escorts Fred into the high-style room
entities.description: Lava walks Fred from the door into a color-coordinated, stylishly decorated room, initiating their meeting.

entities.name: Lava confronts Fred about Barney's loyalty
entities.description: Lava questions Fred about Barney's refusal to take a vacation, suggesting Barney may be more interested in monitoring Lava and the company than in rest.

entities.name: Lava emotionally references Slate's portrait
entities.description: Lava turns to indicate a picture of Slate on the wall, expressing emotional offense at the implication that Barney doubts Slate's or his own capability to run the company.

entities.name: Lava challenges Fred's allegiance to Barney
entities.description: Lava suggests that Fred must choose between supporting Barney and focusing on his own responsibilities, implying Fred has a significant decision to make about loyalty and ambition.

entities.name: Lava offers Fred a cigar
entities.description: Lava offers Fred a cigar, attempting to create a collegial atmosphere while subtly asserting dominance and control over the interaction.

entities.name: Lava uses a lizard to cut cigar tips
entities.description: Lava employs a mechanical frame holding a lizard that bites the tips off cigars, a bizarre and theatrical method that underscores his eccentricity and wealth.

entities.name: Lava ignites a lighter with rubbing twigs
entities.description: Lava uses an unusual lighter that works by rubbing two wooden twigs together rapidly to create fire, highlighting the primitive yet stylized technology in the setting.

entities.name: Lava acknowledges Barney's role in Fibrerock development
entities.description: Lava mentions Barney's involvement in the early stages of Fibrerock's research and development, downplaying his contribution while testing Fred's response.

entities.description: Fred attempts to inflate Barney's role in Fibrerock's development but backtracks under pressure, ultimately characterizing it as minor and indirect.

entities.name: Lava playfully punches Fred while pressuring him to choose sides
entities.description: Lava gives Fred a mock punch, combining false camaraderie with a serious ultimatum about choosing between loyalty to Barney or advancing his own career.

entities.summary: A public exhibition event centered around the newly constructed Slate Needle and Fibresphere, decorated with bunting and promotional banners, celebrating Slate Construction's vision of the future.

entities.summary: A newly constructed city in Bedrock, serving as the central setting for a model city and grand opening celebration, with a visible backdrop and a nearby destination on the Venturock Freeway.

entities.summary: A tall, needle-like tower near the Fibresphere in Slate City serves as a key landmark, visible among the Scrapers, used as a destination, and collapses during a fire emergency.

entities.summary: A large spherical structure in Slate City, linked to the Slate Needle by a gangway, hosts the 'World of Fibre' ride and serves as a key location where Barney and Fred are propelled above an elevator shaft; it is partially damaged by the Needle's collapse and adjacent to an evacuation point reached via Fibrerock.

entities.summary: Bedrock is the fictional prehistoric town where the Flintstones live, serving as the primary setting for the narrative and events such as the school and talent show, located near Slate City.

entities.summary: A wealthy, overdressed woman involved with L'Ecole Superior, wife of Mr. Slate, arrives at the school after a bird destroys her car, comments on being driven, interacts with staff, and attends Slate City's grand opening.

entities.summary: Various characters at Slate Construction and Harvrock University react to the Fibrerock project, office collapse, and Fred and Barney's recognition, including a financial advisor explaining deficits, a worker mistaking debris for Slate's body, and staff involved in project presentations and office operations.

entities.description: Son of Lava, an excitable and entitled child who demands special access at the event.
entities.summary: Son of Lava, an excitable and entitled child, demands special access, chases a police car, seeks to use the Porscherock, and performs an accordion recital met with weak applause, while also pushing through crowds with conflicting priority claims during an evacuation.

entities.name: Piltdown
entities.description: A security guard stationed at the elevator entrance to the Fibresphere, in uniform and carrying a familiar satchel.
entities.summary: A wrecking ball operator engages in unauthorized target practice; a worker sabotages Fred, falsely blaming him; a lodge member protests bias using the Cry of the Gelded Buffalo; another lodge member scowls at Fred; a member joins Fred at a bar; and a Lava employee acts as a thug and later a union provocateur.

entities.name: Pyrite
entities.description: A security guard stationed at the elevator entrance alongside Piltdown, acknowledging Lava upon arrival.
entities.summary: A companion of Piltdown who challenges Fred with walnut smashing, aids in falsely accusing him, and supports Piltdown's complaints at the lodge, later joining others in accusing Fred of betrayal and pushing for the election.

document_metadata.title: 40、EXT. FLINTSTONE HOUSE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Wilma, Betty, the kids, and Dino watch a fashion show featuring Fibrerock clothing replacing fur, followed by a musical display of Fibrerock props and a choir of mechanical animals singing 'It's a Fibre World.'

entities.name: Fred rips off his "FVF" blazer patch in a fit of anger
entities.description: After reflecting on his behavior, Fred suddenly tears the 'FVF' patch from his blazer as a symbolic rejection of his recent actions.

entities.name: Fred smashes a lawn chair against the property divider wall
entities.description: In a burst of rage, Fred uses a lawn chair to violently attack the wall separating his property from Barney's, causing it to crack and splinter and knocking potted plants down.

entities.name: Dino rejects a canape and runs away to Betty's car
entities.description: After tasting a canape Fred offers, Dino makes a disgusted face, spits it out, and runs off to Betty's car, climbing in and driving away.

entities.name: Barney emerges from the rubble of the damaged wall
entities.description: After Fred destroys part of the wall, Barney appears from the wreckage, sneezing and brushing dirt off himself, revealing he was on the other side.

entities.name: Fred apologizes to Barney for his arrogant behavior
entities.description: Overcome with remorse, Fred stumbles through a heartfelt confession, calling himself a jerk and asking Barney if he can ever forgive him.

entities.name: Barney forgives Fred and accepts his apology
entities.description: With humor and warmth, Barney acknowledges Fred's flaws and readily forgives him, saying he's had lots of practice.

entities.name: Fred and Barney share a tearful embrace
entities.description: After reconciling, Fred and Barney hug each other tightly, both crying and slapping each other on the back in a moment of emotional reunion.

document_metadata.title: 47、INT. SLATE NEEDLE
document_metadata.summary: Inside the Slate Needle, vibrations intensify as the building sways, causing a cake to strike Poindexter Lava, who collapses on his accordion, prompting brief applause from partygoers.

entities.name: Poindexter performs dramatic finish during accordion recital
entities.description: Poindexter concludes his accordion performance with a theatrical move, sliding forward on his knees as the recital ends, receiving minimal applause.

entities.name: Audience reacts with half-hearted applause to accordion performance
entities.description: Following Poindexter's recital, a few audience members, led by Lava and the Slates, offer weak and unenthusiastic applause.

entities.name: Headmistress announces next performance by Pebbles, Bam-Bam, and Dino
entities.description: The Headmistress thanks Poindexter and introduces the next act, confirming the performers' names from her notes before stepping aside.

entities.name: Pebbles, Bam-Bam, and Dino begin choreographed 'Dino Dance' performance
entities.description: The children and Dino, now in full costumes with sequins and batons, launch into a fully choreographed version of the 'Dino Dance' accompanied by orchestral music.

entities.name: Mrs. Slate observes judges' positive reaction to Dino Dance
entities.description: Mrs. Slate looks toward the judges and notices they are clearly enjoying the Dino Dance much more than Poindexter's earlier accordion act.

entities.name: Mrs. Slate interrupts performance by barging onto stage
entities.description: Enraged, Mrs. Slate abruptly stands and rushes the stage, halting the ongoing performance and causing the music to stop.

entities.name: Headmistress confronts Mrs. Slate about stage intrusion
entities.description: The Headmistress approaches Mrs. Slate on stage and demands an explanation for her disruptive behavior during the talent show.

entities.name: Mrs. Slate denounces Dino Dance as a disgrace to the talent show
entities.description: Mrs. Slate publicly declares the Dino Dance act an embarrassment, insisting it belongs in a circus rather than a talent competition.

entities.name: Wilma and Betty react furiously to Mrs. Slate's insult
entities.description: Wilma and Betty leap to their feet in anger after Mrs. Slate insults their children's performance, preparing to defend them.

entities.name: Betty retorts that Poindexter belongs in a zoo
entities.description: In response to Mrs. Slate's criticism, Betty fires back, saying that if their act belongs in a circus, then Poindexter belongs in a zoo.

entities.name: Wilma escalates insult by threatening Poindexter's life
entities.description: Wilma adds to Betty's retort by implying Poindexter should be in a zoo for dead animals, threatening violence if he isn't already dead.

He attends nursery, participates in school activities, and is seen with his parents at social events, including a party at the Flintstone House, where he shows reluctance toward formal settings and adult customs.

entities.description: At Mrs. Slate's command, Poindexter starts playing the accordion again after the initial performance, attempting to showcase his talent to the audience.

entities.name: Glass shatters during Poindexter's encore performance
entities.description: As Poindexter plays the accordion in his encore, a glass suddenly shatters, marking the beginning of a series of destructive effects caused by the high-pitched sound.

entities.name: Ceiling fixtures crack due to high-frequency sound vibrations
entities.description: The intense sound from Poindexter's accordion causes the ceiling fixtures in the auditorium to develop cracks, escalating the signs of structural damage.

entities.name: Picture window panels begin to shatter one by one
entities.description: Following the cracking of the ceiling fixtures, the large glass panels of the picture window start breaking sequentially due to resonant vibrations from the music.

entities.name: Mrs. Slate nervously orders Poindexter to stop playing
entities.description: Alarmed by the escalating destruction, Mrs. Slate interrupts Poindexter mid-performance, urging him to cease playing the accordion.

entities.name: Window panel explodes despite Poindexter stopping
entities.description: Even after Poindexter stops playing, one of the window panels violently explodes, indicating that the destructive resonance continues or was already in motion.

entities.name: Table collapses under structural stress
entities.description: A table in the auditorium gives way and collapses, further demonstrating the building's deteriorating structural integrity due to the sonic vibrations.

entities.name: Audience collectively stares at Poindexter in shock
entities.description: After the continued destruction following the cessation of music, everyone in the room turns to look at Poindexter, blaming him for the unfolding disaster.

entities.name: Poindexter nervously discards accordion
entities.description: Feeling the weight of everyone's gaze and the ongoing chaos, Poindexter panics and throws the accordion away in an attempt to stop the destruction.

entities.name: Additional window panel shatters after music stops
entities.description: Another window panel breaks apart even after Poindexter has stopped playing and discarded the instrument, showing the delayed or continuing effect of the resonance.

entities.name: Entire building shakes from distant structural collapse
entities.description: The auditorium experiences strong tremors as the shockwave from collapsing houses reaches the school, causing the whole structure to shake violently.

entities.name: Mr. Slate loses balance and pulls Lava down during building shake
entities.description: As the building shakes, Mr. Slate stumbles, grabs Lava for support, and inadvertently brings him down to the ground as well.

entities.name: Mr. Slate discovers wave of collapsing houses approaching Slate Needle

entities.name: Fred and Barney start moving toward the rising elevator

document_metadata.title: 51、INT. SLATE NEEDLE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: Lava confesses to stealing coo-coo berries to cover stock losses, admitting the sap is unnecessary; Slate attacks him, but structural collapse interrupts the fight, endangering all.

entities.name: Wall section collapses during party
entities.description: A portion of the wall suddenly gives way in the midst of a gathering, causing dust and debris to rise and startling the attendees.

entities.name: Monster mask breaks loose from Fred's costume
entities.description: The damaged mask detaches from Fred's outfit during the commotion, falling to the floor and bouncing away.

entities.name: Piltdown and Pyrite reveal themselves as halves of the xenosaurus
entities.description: The two individuals wearing the costume rise separately, exposing that they were impersonating a single creature called the xenosaurus.

entities.name: Fred accuses Lava of stealing coo-coo berries and falsifying records
entities.description: Fred exposes Lava's scheme to siphon coo-coo berries from the Fibrerock mix and alter financial documents to conceal the theft.

entities.name: Coo-coo berries spill from Piltdown's torn sack
entities.description: The bottom of Piltdown's canvas sack rips open, releasing a large quantity of coo-coo berries onto the floor, providing physical evidence of the theft.

entities.name: Pyrite inadvertently admits the stolen berries were supposed to be real
entities.description: Pyrite expresses disappointment that the real coo-coo berries were not brought up, revealing their intent to steal them and undermining Lava's fake display excuse.

entities.name: Fred recalls the xenosaurus act at the plant
entities.description: Fred connects the current deception to a previous incident at the workplace, identifying the costume act as part of a recurring scheme he now labels 'Plan B'.

entities.name: Party At The Flintstone Residence
entities.description: A social gathering hosted by the Flintstones attended by friends and neighbors, during which the wall collapse and subsequent revelations occur.
entities.summary: A social gathering hosted by the Flintstones attended by friends and neighbors, during which the wall collapse and subsequent revelations occur.

entities.name: Flintstone residence
entities.description: The interior setting where the party and wall collapse occur, identified as the home of the Flintstone family.

entities.name: that night
entities.description: A relative temporal anchor referring to a specific night in the past when the xenosaurus act occurred at the plant.

entities.name: Fred
entities.description: A partygoer and resident of the Flintstone residence who confronts Lava about stolen coo-coo berries and recognizes the xenosaurus act.
entities.summary: A man engages with his family and neighbors in morning routines, car repairs, and shared moments, while reflecting on dreams and offering advice, showing affection and concern in everyday interactions.

entities.name: Barney Rubble
entities.description: A partygoer who rises after the wall collapse and is present during the confrontation with Lava.
entities.summary: Fred interacts with imaginative neighbors, including a dreamer who repairs a car hood and shares memories, while a worker secures a crane on a dino structure and Fred's companion fills out job forms at a quarry.

entities.name: Piltdown
entities.description: The bottom half of the xenosaurus disguise, revealed after the wall collapse, involved in the theft of coo-coo berries.
entities.summary: A wrecking ball operator engages in unauthorized target practice; a worker sabotages Fred, falsely blaming him; a lodge member protests bias using the Cry of the Gelded Buffalo; another lodge member scowls at Fred; a member joins Fred at a bar; and a Lava employee acts as a thug and later a union provocateur.

entities.name: Pyrite
entities.description: The top half of the xenosaurus disguise, who inadvertently reveals that the stolen berries were supposed to be real.
entities.summary: A companion of Piltdown who challenges Fred with walnut smashing, aids in falsely accusing him, and supports Piltdown's complaints at the lodge, later joining others in accusing Fred of betrayal and pushing for the election.

entities.name: Mr. Slate
entities.description: An authority figure present at the party who questions the unfolding events involving Lava and the coo-coo berries.
entities.summary: A person negotiating with Fred and Barney, linked to a company founder called 'Uncle' or 'Mister,' is targeted for a warning about a site collapse, while an authority figure questions events involving Lava and coo-coo berries at a party.

entities.name: Lava
entities.description: An employee accused by Fred of stealing coo-coo berries and falsifying records to cover up the theft.
entities.summary: Various characters at Slate Construction and Harvrock University react to the Fibrerock project, office collapse, and Fred and Barney's recognition, including a financial advisor explaining deficits, a worker mistaking debris for Slate's body, and staff involved in project presentations and office operations.

entities.name: Wilma Flintstone
entities.description: A partygoer at the Flintstone residence who reacts to the chaos following the wall collapse.
entities.summary: Fred's wife interacts with family and neighbors, manages household tasks, addresses a dino kibble shortage, reassures Pebbles, prepares children for school, and visits the butcher shop with Betty, where she helps defuse tension and makes requests for Fred.

entities.name: Betty Rubble
entities.description: A partygoer who dryly comments on the spilled coo-coo berries and questions their authenticity.
entities.summary: A mother helps prepare children for nursery, drives them to school, interacts with Wilma and Mrs. Slate, parks legally using a stone coin, and visits Morris the Butcher's store during a rush.

entities.name: Pebbles Flintstone
entities.description: Fred's daughter who calls out to her father during the commotion at the party.
entities.summary: A young girl, Wilma's daughter Pebbles, interacts with family and friends, attends nursery, plans a talent show with Bam-Bam, and participates in social events, showing affection, fear, and playfulness in various situations.

entities.name: Bam-Bam Rubble
entities.description: Barney's son who calls out to his father during the incident at the party.
entities.summary: A young boy, referred to as Bem-Bem, is Betty's son and a friend of Pebbles. He attends nursery, participates in school activities, and is seen with his parents at social events, including a party at the Flintstone House, where he shows reluctance toward formal settings and adult customs.

entities.name: canvas sack
entities.description: A sack carried by Piltdown that rips open to reveal thousands of stolen coo-coo berries.

entities.name: Coo-Coo Berries
entities.description: Small fruits stolen from the Fibrerock mix and hidden in a sack, central to the fraud accusation against Lava.
entities.summary:
A commodity being delivered in sacks via armored car, used in the production of Fibrerock by Flintstone and Rubble.
Small fruits stolen from the Fibrerock mix and hidden in a sack, central to the fraud accusation against Lava.

entities.name: Lava confesses to stealing coo-coo berries and tampering with Fibrerock mix
entities.description: Under pressure, Lava admits to stealing coo-coo berries, using them to replace Woca sap in the Fibrerock mix, and orchestrating monster-related crimes to cover financial losses from the stock market.

entities.name: Mister Slate attempts to attack Lava in rage
entities.description: Upon realizing Lava's sabotage compromised the structural integrity of Fibrerock, Mister Slate lunges at Lava in fury, snarling and attempting to harm him before being restrained.

entities.name: Fred and Barney restrain Mister Slate and Lava
entities.description: Fred and Barney intervene physically to separate Mister Slate and Lava during their violent confrontation, preventing further conflict.

entities.name: Building structure deteriorates further with falling dust and beams
entities.description: As tension peaks, the building continues to shake, with dust and wooden beams falling, signaling escalating structural failure and imminent danger to occupants.

entities.name: Slate
entities.description: A character who reacts with rage upon realizing the structural instability of Fibrerock due to the absence of coo-coo berry sap, and attempts to attack Lava.
entities.summary: A project developer and Slate Construction leadership face financial, logistical, and structural crises, leading to office destruction, emotional reactions, and a pivotal shift toward a new construction era with the Fibrerock name, while key figures make decisions about Slate City's development.

document_metadata.title: 52、EXT. SLATE NEEDLE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The pythonsaurus admires Fred's costume, feels dejected upon recognizing him, and follows the group to safety as Slate Needle collapses behind them.

entities.name: Rescue vehicles arrive at burning building with sirens wailing
entities.description: Emergency vehicles, including police cars and rescue trucks, arrive rapidly at the scene of a burning building, sirens blaring, coming to an abrupt stop to begin rescue operations.

entities.name: Firefighters prepare equipment to rescue people from burning building
entities.description: Rescue workers exit the vehicles and begin deploying ladders and carrying fire-resistant trampolines made of hide and bamboo frames to attempt a rescue from the upper floors.

entities.name: Hook and ladder truck reveals firesaurus instead of mechanical ladder
entities.description: A close-up shows that the so-called hook and ladder truck carries a living creature called a firesaurus with a long neck and bony plates used as stairs, rather than a conventional ladder system.

entities.name: Firesaurus refuses to cooperate due to food shortage
entities.description: The firesaurus is listless and unresponsive because of a kibble shortage, delaying rescue efforts as firefighters report they've been on half-rations for a month.

entities.name: Building shudders and interior light fixtures crash down
entities.description: The structure of the building violently shakes, causing the remaining light fixtures to fall to the floor, breaking and spreading fire as oil from the lamps ignites.

entities.name: Fire spreads rapidly, blocking access to fire hose
entities.description: Fred and Barney attempt to reach a fire hose in a glass case, but the flames quickly expand and cut off their path, forcing them to retreat helplessly.

entities.name: Slate skyscrapers collapse with thunderous roar
entities.description: Two tall slate buildings visible through the window suddenly give way and collapse dramatically, marking a critical escalation in the disaster.

entities.name: Statue of Slate disintegrates and crashes through window
entities.description: The large external statue of Slate deteriorates like a sand sculpture, shrinking in size before its head breaks off, smashes through the last remaining glass pane, and rolls to Slate's feet.

entities.name: Characters embrace as building faces imminent destruction
entities.description: Realizing the end is near, Fred embraces Wilma, Barney embraces Betty, children are pulled into the group, and even Slate takes his wife's hand in a moment of shared dread and solidarity.

entities.name: Grace's costume decomposes, revealing undergarments
entities.description: The fashion model Grace's Fibrethread outfit suddenly breaks down, leaving her exposed in animal-print underwear during the crisis, prompting Betty to shield Bam-Bam's eyes.

entities.name: Bam-Bam expresses fear about survival
entities.description: Amid the chaos, Bam-Bam turns to Barney and asks with trembling voice whether they will be okay, showing his fear as the building collapses around them.

entities.name: Barney gives false reassurance about fire department rescue
entities.description: Barney responds to Bam-Bam's fear with a forced smile, claiming they just need to wait for the fire department, attempting to maintain calm despite the hopeless situation.

entities.name: Fred reacts with shock as situation worsens
entities.description: Fred begins to echo Barney's reassurance but is cut off by a sudden development, reacting with alarm and exclaiming in distress as new danger emerges.

entities.name: Slate Needle
entities.description: A specific skyscraper where the characters are trapped during the fire emergency.
entities.summary: A tall, needle-like tower near the Fibresphere in Slate City serves as a key landmark, visible among the Scrapers, used as a destination, and collapses during a fire emergency.

entities.description: The leader of the firefighting team who demands to know the reason for the delay in rescue operations.

entities.name: Firefighter
entities.description: A member of the rescue team who explains the delay is due to the kibble crisis affecting the firesauruses.

document_metadata.title: 52、EXT. SLATE NEEDLE - NIGHT
document_metadata.summary: The pythonsaurus admires Fred's costume, feels dejected upon recognizing him, and follows the group to safety as Slate Needle collapses behind them.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus detects smoke and pauses attentively
entities.description: The Pythonsaurus stirs, looks at Fred, and mimics sniffing the smoke, then raises a finger as if signaling 'one moment' before turning toward a nozzle.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus drinks large quantity of water
entities.description: The Pythonsaurus turns its head toward a nozzle resembling those in hamster cages and slurps loudly, causing gallons of water to gurgle away from a hidden reservoir.

entities.name: Guests retreat from fire in main room
entities.description: As the fire spreads, all the guests in the main room back away to avoid the flames, creating distance for safety.

entities.name: Slate retrieves head of statue as souvenir
entities.description: Slate picks up the severed head of a statue during the chaos, keeping it as his only memento from the event.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus finishes drinking and prepares to act
entities.description: After finishing its drink, the Pythonsaurus daintily wipes its mouth with a napkin, puts on a small fire helmet, and gets ready to reenter the main room.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus unrolls from hidden compartment
entities.description: As the creature moves forward, yards of its body unroll from a concealed space behind a box, revealing its true length.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus extinguishes fire with water jet
entities.description: The Pythonsaurus runs into the main room and shoots water from its mouth, dousing all the flames in the area.

entities.name: Fred performs complete fire suppression
entities.description: Fred turns in a semi-circle while operating the Pythonsaurus, ensuring every flame in the room is put out.

entities.name: Guests celebrate Pythonsaurus's fire rescue
entities.description: After the fire is extinguished, all the guests cheer, rush toward the Pythonsaurus, and slap it on the back in appreciation.

entities.name: Pebbles jumps on and kisses Pythonsaurus
entities.description: Overcome with emotion, Pebbles leaps onto the Pythonsaurus and kisses it in gratitude for saving everyone from the fire.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus acknowledges crowd attention
entities.description: The Pythonsaurus looks around at the celebrating guests, seemingly aware of and responding to the admiration it is receiving.

entities.name: main room
entities.description: The primary interior space where the fire occurs and guests retreat from the flames.

entities.name: behind the box
entities.description: A concealed area in the room where the Pythonsaurus unrolls from a hidden compartment.

entities.name: other room
entities.description: A connected space to the main room, into which the Pythonsaurus runs after preparing to act.

entities.name: Fred
entities.description: A character who participates in fire suppression and is celebrated by guests after the fire is extinguished.
entities.summary: A man engages with his family and neighbors in morning routines, car repairs, and shared moments, while reflecting on dreams and offering advice, showing affection and concern in everyday interactions.

entities.name: Slate
entities.description: A character who retrieves the head of a statue as a souvenir during the incident in the main room.
entities.summary: A project developer and Slate Construction leadership face financial, logistical, and structural crises, leading to office destruction, emotional reactions, and a pivotal shift toward a new construction era with the Fibrerock name, while key figures make decisions about Slate City's development.

entities.name: Pebbles Flintstone
entities.description: A character who expresses affection toward Pythonsaurus by jumping on and kissing him after the fire rescue.
entities.summary: A young girl, Wilma's daughter Pebbles, interacts with family and friends, attends nursery, plans a talent show with Bam-Bam, and participates in social events, showing affection, fear, and playfulness in various situations.

entities.name: fire helmet
entities.description: A small helmet placed on Pythonsaurus's head before it runs back into the other room to extinguish the fire.

entities.name: nozzle
entities.description: A device resembling those in hamster cages, used by Pythonsaurus to drink large quantities of water.

entities.name: napkin
entities.description: A cloth used by Pythonsaurus to wipe its mouth after drinking water.

entities.name: Head Of Statue
entities.description: A sculptural fragment picked up by Slate as a souvenir during the evacuation from the fire.
entities.summary: A sculptural fragment picked up by Slate as a souvenir during the evacuation from the fire.

entities.name: Barney creates escape path with flit gun in Fibrerock
entities.description: Barney uses his flit gun to solidify a pathway through the crumbling Fibrerock, enabling the group to escape safely.

entities.name: Barney and Fred assist group into adjacent Fibresphere
entities.description: After creating the path, Barney and Fred stand back and gesture for the others to proceed into the neighboring Fibresphere, facilitating the evacuation.

entities.name: Poindexter pushes through crowd with contradictory priority claims
entities.description: Poindexter shoves through the group while announcing evacuation priorities, first claiming children and women, then hesitating and qualifying the order based on available space.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus inspects Fred's costume and reacts to revealed identity
entities.description: The Pythonsaurus looks Fred up and down in his costume, appears intrigued, then reacts with disappointment upon seeing Fred's true face when the monster head is removed.

entities.name: Pythonsaurus departs dejectedly after Fred's identity reveal
entities.description: After realizing Fred is not who the costume suggested, the Pythonsaurus becomes depressed and follows the group into the Fibresphere with low morale.

entities.name: Fred and Barney enter Fibresphere as Slate Needle collapses
entities.description: Fred and Barney cross into the Fibresphere just as the structure known as Slate Needle fully collapses, marking a critical structural failure.

entities.name: Fibrerock
entities.summary: An invention created by Barney that has become the basis of a significant business deal involving Fred and Mister Slate.

entities.name: Fibresphere
entities.description: An adjacent physical setting where the group evacuates to safety after escaping through Fibrerock.
entities.summary: A large spherical structure in Slate City, linked to the Slate Needle by a gangway, hosts the 'World of Fibre' ride and serves as a key location where Barney and Fred are propelled above an elevator shaft; it is partially damaged by the Needle's collapse and adjacent to an evacuation point reached via Fibrerock.

entities.description: A costumed character who reacts emotionally to Fred's identity reveal and follows the group to safety.
entities.summary: A costumed character who reacts emotionally to Fred's identity reveal and follows the group to safety.

entities.summary: Fred interacts with imaginative neighbors, including a dreamer who repairs a car hood and shares memories, while a worker secures a crane on a dino structure and Fred's companion fills out job forms at a quarry.

entities.summary: Son of Lava, an excitable and entitled child, demands special access, chases a police car, seeks to use the Porscherock, and performs an accordion recital met with weak applause, while also pushing through crowds with conflicting priority claims during an evacuation.

document_metadata.title: 53、EXT. FIBRESPHERE - LONG SHOT
document_metadata.summary: Fibrerock, now edible, is devoured by dinosaurs and Dino; Barney realizes it's transformed into Dino kibble, making Fred and Barney rich, causing Slate to faint as the camera pulls back.

entities.name: Dino performs the Dino Dance to rescue the children and friends
entities.description: Dino mimics the steps of the Dino Dance, dives through bamboo hoops, carries two children on his shoulders, and slides down a long wire with Fred and Barney to deliver everyone safely into a rescue net.

entities.name: Wilma and Betty perform a dance routine rejecting modern dances
entities.description: Wilma and Betty sing and dance, declaring they do not need to shimmy or bop because they are performing the 'Igneous Rock,' a new dance inspired by Fred's earlier performance.

entities.name: Fred is surrounded by a police cordon led by Feldspar
entities.description: After being rescued, Fred sits up dazed and finds himself surrounded by armed police officers, with spotlights operated by uniformed monkeys, all aiming weapons at him as Feldspar prepares to shoot.

entities.name: Feldspar orders his men to open fire on Fred
entities.description: Feldspar, identifying Fred as the 'xenosaurus,' commands his officers to ready their weapons and aim at Fred, initiating a barrage of gunfire and projectiles.

entities.name: Fred attempts to remove the dinosaur head costume under fire
entities.description: While taking cover behind a chunk of Fibrerock, Fred desperately tries to remove the dinosaur head by banging it against a wall and tearing at it with his claws.

entities.name: Fibrerock cover protecting Fred decomposes under gunfire
entities.description: The chunk of Fibrerock that Fred uses for shelter begins to break down and disintegrate, leaving him exposed and back in the line of fire.

entities.name: spindly bridge
entities.description: A fragile, narrow bridge connecting two islands, used by Dino during the rescue.

entities.name: island
entities.description: A landmass separated by water, referenced as the destination Dino reaches during the rescue.

entities.name: long wire
entities.description: A suspended cable used by Dino to slide to safety while carrying the children and friends.

entities.name: rescue net
entities.description: A large net used to catch the group after their slide to safety.

entities.name: fallen chunk of Fibrerock
entities.description: A large piece of protective rock debris that Fred uses as cover from gunfire.

entities.name: police cordon
entities.description: A围 line of police officers surrounding Fred, each with weapons drawn and spotlights active.

entities.name: Dino
entities.description: A dinosaur character who performs a dance routine to rescue children and friends, demonstrating courage and coordination.
entities.summary: A pet dinosaur named Dino belongs to the Flintstone family, displaying playful, affectionate behavior with the family, participating in routines like fetching the newspaper, performing in talent shows, and undergoing humorous grooming experiences.

entities.name: Fred
entities.description: A character in a dinosaur costume who is mistaken for a dangerous creature and comes under police fire.
entities.summary: A man engages with his family and neighbors in morning routines, car repairs, and shared moments, while reflecting on dreams and offering advice, showing affection and concern in everyday interactions.

entities.name: Wilma Flintstone
entities.description: A woman who performs a dance rejecting modern dances alongside Betty, contributing to Dino's inspiration and the rescue.
entities.summary: Fred's wife interacts with family and neighbors, manages household tasks, addresses a dino kibble shortage, reassures Pebbles, prepares children for school, and visits the butcher shop with Betty, where she helps defuse tension and makes requests for Fred.

entities.name: Betty Rubble
entities.description: A woman who performs a dance rejecting modern dances alongside Wilma, contributing to Dino's inspiration and the rescue.
entities.summary: A mother helps prepare children for nursery, drives them to school, interacts with Wilma and Mrs. Slate, parks legally using a stone coin, and visits Morris the Butcher's store during a rush.

entities.name: Sergeant Feldspar
entities.description: A police officer leading a cordon of officers aiming to shoot Fred, believing him to be a dangerous creature.
entities.summary: Police officers pursue Fred, Barney, and Piltdown at a quarry and construction site, with one officer eager for a promotion via a xenosaurus sighting, while an armed guard confronts Fred at night.

entities.name: Barney Rubble
entities.description: A character who assists in the rescue by receiving Fred's tail and helping pull everyone to safety.
entities.summary: Fred interacts with imaginative neighbors, including a dreamer who repairs a car hood and shares memories, while a worker secures a crane on a dino structure and Fred's companion fills out job forms at a quarry.

entities.name: uniformed monkeys
entities.description: Monkeys operating spotlights for the police cordon, wearing uniforms and assisting in the confrontation with Fred.

entities.name: dinosaur head costume
entities.description: A costume worn by Fred that he struggles to remove while under gunfire, contributing to his mistaken identity.

entities.name: shotgun
entities.description: A weapon cocked by Feldspar, aimed at Fred during the police confrontation.

entities.name: elastic catapults
entities.description: Mechanisms attached to weapons that twitch menacingly as the police prepare to fire on Fred.

entities.name: scraps of wood
entities.description: Materials grabbed by characters to use in a dance performance, contributing to the narrative's rhythm and resistance.

entities.name: fire fighter's helmets
entities.description: Helmets borrowed by characters for use in a dance performance, symbolizing defiance of modern trends.

entities.name: bamboo hoops
entities.description: Obstacles that Dino dives through while performing the Dino Dance on his way to rescue Fred and the others.

entities.name: xenosaurus
entities.description: A label used by Feldspar to identify Fred in the dinosaur costume as a dangerous, non-human creature.

entities.name: Dino races forward and removes Fred's monster suit pants to reveal striped undershorts
entities.description: Dino swiftly moves toward Fred, grabs the seat of his monster suit, and pulls down the pants, exposing Fred's distinctive striped undershorts.

entities.name: Officer Gravel recognizes Fred from his striped undershorts and orders cease fire
entities.description: After seeing Fred's large striped undershorts, Officer Gravel realizes Fred's identity and commands the police to stop shooting.

entities.name: Fred's dinosaur head costume fully comes off confirming his identity
entities.description: The dinosaur head costume finally detaches from Fred, clearly revealing his face and confirming his identity to the police.

entities.name: All police officers lower their guns except Feldspar who is disarmed by Gravel
entities.description: Following the recognition of Fred, the police lower their weapons, but Feldspar attempts to continue firing until Gravel intervenes and wrestles the gun away.

entities.name: The Flintstones and Rubbles safely reunite and embrace at dawn
entities.description: After the danger passes, Fred, Wilma, Barney, Betty, and the children emotionally reunite and embrace one another in relief.

entities.name: Police transport Piltdown, Pyrite, and Lava in a squad car while Poindexter chases after
entities.description: A police vehicle carries away the captured criminals Piltdown, Pyrite, and Lava, with Poindexter Lava running after it and calling out to his father.

entities.name: Poindexter asks if he can use the Porscherock while his father is imprisoned
entities.description: From a distance, Poindexter calls out to his father, asking whether he can use the Porscherock car while his father is in jail.

entities.name: dawn
entities.description: A specific time of day indicating when the characters reunite after the incident.

entities.name: Gravel
entities.description: A police officer who recognizes Fred Flintstone by his striped undershorts and orders the cease fire, disarming Feldspar when he refuses to comply.
entities.summary: Feldspar's police partner and squad members respond to incidents involving a Radar Bird, a creature attack, and Xenosaurus sightings, with one discovering clawprints and reacting in fear while others report events nervously or exhaustingly.

entities.name: Piltdown
entities.description: A character arrested and transported in a police squad car along with Pyrite and Lava.
entities.summary: A wrecking ball operator engages in unauthorized target practice; a worker sabotages Fred, falsely blaming him; a lodge member protests bias using the Cry of the Gelded Buffalo; another lodge member scowls at Fred; a member joins Fred at a bar; and a Lava employee acts as a thug and later a union provocateur.

entities.name: Pyrite
entities.description: A character arrested and transported in a police squad car along with Piltdown and Lava.
entities.summary: A companion of Piltdown who challenges Fred with walnut smashing, aids in falsely accusing him, and supports Piltdown's complaints at the lodge, later joining others in accusing Fred of betrayal and pushing for the election.

entities.name: Lava
entities.description: A character arrested and transported in a police squad car, father of Poindexter.
entities.summary: Various characters at Slate Construction and Harvrock University react to the Fibrerock project, office collapse, and Fred and Barney's recognition, including a financial advisor explaining deficits, a worker mistaking debris for Slate's body, and staff involved in project presentations and office operations.

entities.name: Poindexter Lava
entities.description: The son of Lava who chases the police car and asks if he can use the Porscherock while his father is imprisoned.
entities.summary: Son of Lava, an excitable and entitled child, demands special access, chases a police car, seeks to use the Porscherock, and performs an accordion recital met with weak applause, while also pushing through crowds with conflicting priority claims during an evacuation.

entities.name: Porscherock
entities.description: A vehicle presumably owned by Lava that Poindexter asks to use while his father is in jail.
entities.summary:
Lava's vehicle, a rock-themed car that serves as a distinctive personal object in the narrative.
